credentials.description: Notch Pay public key, sent as is in Authorization; a key containing test_ works in sandbox (same host for test and live)
Notch Pay private key, sent as is in X-Grant, for transfers, beneficiaries, balance and webhooks

example_prompt: List all registered Notch Pay webhook endpoints for my account.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of webhook endpoints per page.

endpoints.description: Array of registered webhook endpoint objects. Note: top-level array is named 'endpoints', not 'items'.

totals.description: Total number of registered webhook endpoints.

selected.description: Number of endpoints returned in this page.

gotchas: Authorization takes your public key as is, with no 'Bearer ' prefix, and X-Grant your private key (Notch Pay's Authentication page: `-H "Authorization: YOUR_PUBLIC_KEY"` `-H "X-Grant: YOUR_PRIVATE_KEY"`).
All query parameters are optional. Omitting them returns the full paginated list with the API default page size.
The top-level array is named 'endpoints' (not 'items'). Pagination uses 'totals' (not 'total') and 'selected' (not 'per_page'). Reading the wrong field name silently returns undefined.
Iterate through pages by incrementing the page param and stop when current_page equals last_page.

This endpoint also requires the `X-Grant` header carrying your private key (`X-Grant: YOUR_PRIVATE_KEY`). Without it Notch Pay returns 403 "This endpoint requires additional authentication"; a wrong value returns 403 "Invalid grant key".
